decision.rationale: Research laboratory, group, centre, forest or research project. Home/about/team/publications default to research, not stories merely because they mention people.
evidence: https://sal-lab.landfood.ubc.ca/ | SAL Lab Home Page | Sustainable Agricultural Landscapes Lab

rules.rationale: Named story, testimonial and spotlight sections contain profiles or narratives.
Titles explicitly identify a profile or spotlight narrative.
Recipient, winner and congratulation titles report an outcome rather than an open application.
Titles explicitly identify a retrospective recap or highlights report.
Explicit opportunities and funding sections remain participation information within broader academic paths.
Named openings, funding and event sections describe participation; archived event pages retain their historical category.
Named help, service, policy, procedure and contact sections provide practical support.
Named research, publication and project sections describe scholarly work.
Named news, announcement and update sections publish institutional reports.

fallback.rationale: Research laboratory, group, centre, forest or research project. Home/about/team/publications default to research, not stories merely because they mention people.
